newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Corimon sells Colorin for $3.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Corimon sells Colorin for $3.5 mln.

text.p: Venezuelan paints and packaging company Corimon completed Tuesday the sale of its Argentine subsidiary Colorin to Consorcio Bisa for $3.5 million, a company spokeswoman said Wednesday.
Bisa, also Argentine bought a 100 percent stake in Colorin, the spokeswoman said.
The sale of Colorin is part of a restructuring process in which Corimon has shed most of its international assets.

Corimon recently reached an agreement with creditors to restructure $95 million in debt with an eye to resuming trade of its shares on the New York and Caracas Stock Exchanges. Trade in Corimon was suspended in February.
